name: furigana-sensei
description: Chrome extension that adds furigana readings above kanji on any Japanese web page.

scripts.sync-vendor: cp node_modules/kuromoji/build/kuromoji.js vendor/kuromoji.js && cp node_modules/kuromoji/dict/*.dat.gz vendor/dict/
scripts.build: rm -f dist/furigana-sensei.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -qr dist/furigana-sensei.zip manifest.json src vendor data icons -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'dist/furigana-sensei.zip'
